b01a.what: The CNS home shot, held still for 1 s (no breathing, no lamp flicker): reclined at 45 degrees on one pillow, trousers rolled above the knees, sheet folded at the foot, arms resting, the gloved hands resting flat at his right side.
b01a.sound: Room ambience fades in over 0.5 s

b01b.what: A slow push-in toward both legs; his face stays in frame for the question in beat 2.
b01b.camera: One continuous dolly from the home shot to "overview" (1.0-4.6 s)

b02a.what: HOLD 5.0-6.5 s (the examiner asks about pain in the hips, knees or legs). He answers "no": silent visemes E-O-M at 5.85-6.45 s, no sound. No caption.

b02b.what: The camera travels slowly along both legs: above the knees, the knees, the shins, the calves, the feet. Hands at rest.
b02b.camera: One continuous move 6.5-12.7 s: insThigh, insKnee, insShin, insCalf, insFeet

b02c.what: The feet, both lying the same way.

b03a.what: HOLD 13.0-14.5 s (the examiner asks him to let his legs go floppy). No caption.
b03a.camera: Hard cut to "toneR": from his right side, low, at knee height, the whole leg

b03b.what: The examiner's right palm on the front of the lower thigh and knee rolls the leg: externally rotated (hipRot +25), the foot flops out.
b03b.sound: Soft mattress rustle on each turn

b03c.what: Rolled in (hipRot -25), the foot flops in; twice in all (15.1-19.1 s).

b03d.what: The hand slides under the knee (palm up), lifts it briskly (knee 20 -> 45 degrees in 0.4 s, about 15 cm): the heel slides up the bed and stays on it; then lowered gently.

b04a.what: Hard cut to his LEFT (the examiner has walked round): the same roll of the left leg.
b04a.camera: "toneL": from his left side, across the bed

b04b.what: The left knee lifted briskly, the heel sliding on the bed; lowered; then a hard cut back to his right side (33.6 s).
b04b.camera: toneL, then a cut to hipflexR

b05a.camera: hipflexR: from his right side at bed height

b05b.what: He lifts his straight right leg about 30 cm (hipFlex 21); the examiner's palm presses down just above the knee; he holds (the leg gives 2.5 mm, then holds).

b05c.what: Hard cut to his LEFT: the same.
b05c.sound: Rustle as the leg is lowered

b06a.camera: hipextR: from his right side, low

b06b.what: The examiner's palm under his right heel lifts it 5 cm; he pushes down into the hand and holds (the hand does not rise).

b06c.what: Hard cut to his LEFT: the same.

b07b.what: Knee bent, foot flat on the bed; the palm cups the back of the heel; he pulls the heel in and holds (the hamstrings firm).
b07b.sound: Rustle as the heel slides up

b07c.what: Hard cut to his LEFT: the same.

b08b.what: Knee bent 60 degrees over the examiner's left forearm (heel on the bed); the right palm on the lower shin; he straightens against it and holds (the quadriceps firms).

b08c.what: Hard cut to his LEFT: the same.

b09a.camera: dorsiR: from his right side at foot height

b09b.what: He pulls the foot up (ankle +15); the palm presses down on the top of the foot; he holds (tibialis anterior stands out).

b09c.what: Hard cut to his LEFT: the same.

b10a.camera: plantarR: from his right side at foot height

b10b.what: The palm flat on the ball of the foot; he pushes down like a pedal (ankle -20) and holds (the calf firms).

b10c.what: Hard cut to his LEFT: the same; then a hard cut back to his right side (81.0 s).

b11a.what: Both legs straight, the hands at rest; the camera pulls back.
b11a.camera: One continuous move plantarR -> home (81.3-84.0 s)

b11b.what: The CNS home shot, held still for the last second: pixel-identical to the first frame.
b11b.sound: Room ambience fades out over the last 0.5 s

caps.text: Look: no wasting, no fasciculation; the legs lie equally
Tone: roll the leg, lift the knee briskly - the heel slides on the bed: normal
Same on the left: normal tone
Hip flexion (L1, L2): lift your leg, don't let me push it down - full power
Hip extension (L5, S1): push down into the bed - full power
Knee flexion (L5, S1): pull your heel in - full power
Knee extension (L3, L4): straighten, push me away - full power
Ankle dorsiflexion (L4, L5): pull your foot up - full power
Plantar flexion (S1): push down like a pedal - full power
